# Videos Folder

Drop your local video files here. The code expects:

- `rain.mp4` — your first video wallpaper
- `cyber.mp4` — your second video wallpaper

Put matching thumbnail screenshots in `thumbs/`:
- `thumbs/rain.jpg`
- `thumbs/cyber.jpg`

## Tips
- **Duration:** 5-10 seconds, looping
- **Resolution:** 720p or 1080p
- **Size:** 1-3 MB each (compress with HandBrake or similar)
- **Format:** MP4 with H.264 codec

To add more videos, just add entries in the `wallpapers` array in `script.js`.
